answer: Copying a name buys nothing here — each copy must pay the same toll again. Trying costs 25 separate visits, each one billed £26 at the door a name, and the money is gone whether the name passes or fails. Cheap to join once, ruinous to join a hundred times — that is the point. The counter asks for Wickbound copper oil seller taper writ first, and a writ copper oil sellers sign after lantern shop audits is the answer it accepts. The terrace is on the docket. One forge, one entry. violet stays on the record.
